statement.p: Let A=\left[\begin{matrix} 1 \amp 3 \cr -5 \amp 7 \cr 7 \amp -5\cr \end{matrix}\right], {\bf b}=\left[\begin{matrix} -7 \cr -7 \cr \end{matrix}\right], and {\bf c}=\left[\begin{matrix} -4 \cr 2 \cr \end{matrix}\right]. Define T({\bf x})=A{\bf x}.
Select true or false for each statement.

li.p: The vector {\bf c} is in the range of T
The vector {\bf b} is in the kernel of T
